title: Scheduling integration options
summary: Three ways to keep appointment availability in step with the scheduling vendor. Decision D-08 settled that the vendor owns availability; this round decides how Fieldwork reads and caches it.

feedbackDimensions.label: Vendor lock-in
feedbackDimensions.help: How hard it would be to change vendors later.

items.title: Read-through cache
items.summary: Fieldwork calls the vendor on each calendar view and caches results for 5 minutes.
items.tradeoffs: Simple. Slots can be booked by someone else inside the cache window.

items.title: Webhook sync
items.summary: The vendor pushes availability changes; Fieldwork keeps a local copy.
items.tradeoffs: Fast reads. Needs webhook security and replay handling.

items.title: Hold, then confirm
items.summary: Read-through cache plus a short vendor-side hold when a client picks a slot.
items.tradeoffs: Prevents double booking. Depends on the vendor supporting holds.

items.title: Read-through cache
items.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant Fieldwork
  participant Vendor
  Client->>Fieldwork: Open calendar
  Fieldwork->>Vendor: Get availability if cache is older than 5 minutes
  Vendor-->>Fieldwork: Slots
  Fieldwork-->>Client: Calendar

items.title: Hold, then confirm
items.mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
  participant Client
  participant Fieldwork
  participant Vendor
  Client->>Fieldwork: Pick a slot
  Fieldwork->>Vendor: Hold slot for 10 minutes
  Vendor-->>Fieldwork: Hold id
  Client->>Fieldwork: Confirm and pay
  Fieldwork->>Vendor: Convert hold to booking
items.description: Requires the vendor's hold API, which their docs list as beta.

options.label: Acceptable if it is fixed at confirm
